dus0: Can this checklist tell me for certain whether I will fall?
dus1: No. The UK national health guideline from NICE (2025) advises against using a questionnaire or scoring tool on its own to predict falls risk, and the 2022 World Falls Guidelines start the assessment by asking whether you have fallen in the past 12 months. So if you have fallen in the past year, tell your doctor whatever your score. If you have fallen more than once, were injured in a fall, lost consciousness or could not get up from the floor without help, you can ask for a full falls assessment.
